messages:
alice-support: FYI -- customer 'BoxLabs' opened a ticket: intermittent 503s + timeouts hitting /v1/generate around 12:08-12:35 UTC. They attached curl logs and request IDs.

alice-support: Example error: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` with body `\{"error\":\"gateway timeout\"\}`. Customer experiencing elevated latency and failed requests.

tim-oncall: I'm on it. Spinning up war room. Looking at apigateway traces -> 503 spike aligns with a fanout at 12:09. Correlating to inference pool eu-west-1.

jordan-sre: Observed: tail p95/p99 spike, many requests had seqlen ~2048 and batch sizes grew. Some pods reported OOMs then restarted. Autoscaler did not react quickly because cooldown is 2m.

sasha-ml: Adding that this tenant has a sudden concurrency burst (x3 baseline) with long contexts. We have a lighter quantized variant available; can route as fallback.

jordan-sre: Immediate mitigations applied: (a) manual scale-up of inference pool at 12:22, (b) per-tenant connection limit on gateway at 12:24, (c) enabled model fallback routing for BoxLabs at 12:27.

deploy-bot: Rollout: model-fallback routing revision r12 -> canary 25% at 12:27 by sasha-ml.

alice-support: Customer updated at 12:30, they reduced client concurrency after we asked. Error rate dropped noticeably. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.

tim-oncall: Metrics show error rate back to baseline by 12:40. Marking incident contained. We should create postmortem with action items.

jordan-sre: Proposed action items (owners):
- eng-runtime: lower autoscaler cooldown for inference pools from 120s -> 30s (owner: @jordan-sre).
- eng-platform: implement tenant-level token-bucket throttling and per-tenant queue caps (owner: @maria-platform)
- eng-ml: add seqlen-aware routing (route seqlen>1024 to dedicated heavy-pool or fallback quantized models) (owner: @sasha-ml)
- eng-infra: surface OOM and batch-size metrics in dashboard + alert on repeated restarts (owner: @lee-infra)
- support: prepare customer post-incident comms and checklist for heavy clients (owner: @alice-support).

sasha-ml: We'll also publish a short runbook: when heavy seqlen clients spike, enable fallback variant and increase pool capacity, plus recommended client-side concurrency limits.

alice-support: I'll draft comms and include recommended mitigations and timeline.

tim-oncall: I'll open the postmortem doc and link GH issues for the action items. Please add short acceptance criteria for each task. Good catch from everyone :thumbsup:

jordan-sre: Quick log snippet for ops notes:
```
12:21:43 pod-xyz kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4321 (python)
12:21:44 pod-xyz kubelet: Container exited with status OOMKilled
12:22:10 autoscaler: no scale up, cooldown remaining 68s
```

alice-support: Tagging followups for tomorrow's triage. Thanks all. :handshake:
